detail: Pyramid Technoplast Limited submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to the National Stock Exchange. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of substantial acquisitions of shares within 48 hours of such acquisition crossing prescribed thresholds. The filing was processed on 28 April 2026 (per NSE archive metadata) and reported on 6 July 2026. The specific acquirer identity, number of shares, consideration, and post-acquisition intentions are not detailed in the headline disclosure itself; full details would appear in the detailed Regulation 31(4) Form.
